intent:
Split this across subagents, one per part:

1. Add about.html — a short page saying what this project is.
2. Add credits.html — a short page listing the files in the repo and what each is for.
3. Add a footer to index.html with links to about.html and credits.html.\
   This one needs parts 1 and 2 landed first.
4. Add a "Pages" section to README.md listing index.html, about.html and credits.html.\
   This one also needs parts 1 and 2 landed first.

Every page keeps index.html's style: dark background, centred text, styles\
inside the file, no build step. Change nothing else.
